items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Wanda playing it' as a comparison for lively playing; the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of knowing Wanda.

ctx.x: There's lots of that that I would just practically done forgotten now.

We don't come to you as soon as we get the machine apart. That's always the way. I've recorded a lot of groups and they're usually rather stiff while they're playing. As soon as I start to put the equipment away everybody springs into life and starts to play like Wanda playing it. You can stop it.
